sources.title: Code of Virginia, Title 32.1, Chapter 5, Article 2 — Rights and Responsibilities of Patients in Nursing Homes (§§ 32.1-137.01 through 32.1-138.6)
sources.source_date: sections carry their own enactment lines; § 32.1-138.1 ends 1987, c. 221; 1993, c. 692
sources.notes: The standing packet's own method is 'reduced to text mechanically (tag strip over the served document)' with no scope narrower than the whole page — LIS's own site chrome (the General Assembly nav, the search-type picker) is left in as served. 'body' matches that: it is the widest legal scope and adds nothing the standing packet did not already carry. Plain curl with a browser user-agent is enough; no WAF sits in front of this host.
